subject.title: Plugin register() promises silently ignored — async registration not awaited

question: Should this be resolved as a nix-openclaw packaged-artifact mismatch under the existing synchronous register() contract, or sponsored upstream as a new asynchronous plugin lifecycle?
rationale: Awaiting registration promises changes startup ordering, failure handling, and the established OpenClaw plugin contract, while artifact correctness for supported runtime plugins belongs to this repository.

options.title: Align packaged plugins
options.body: Keep register() synchronous and fix or repin any packaged acpx/browser implementation that returns a promise.

options.title: Redesign upstream lifecycle
options.body: Sponsor an upstream design that defines async registration ordering, startup failure, cleanup, and compatibility semantics.

recommendation.title: Align packaged plugins
recommendation.body: Keep register() synchronous and fix or repin any packaged acpx/browser implementation that returns a promise.

likelyOwner.reason: The narrow recommended path begins with runtime-plugin artifact packaging and revision alignment.
